## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** 特洛伊晚青铜时代毁灭以后的人口连续性、复居时间与公共空间再利用，是理解Troy VI/VII到铁器时代Ilion转变的重要问题。所谓“agora”尤其需要谨慎，因为它是一个带有古典城邦制度含义的功能术语，把它用于晚青铜时代空间需要建筑、活动面、出土物和比较材料共同支持。

**English.** Population continuity, the timing of reoccupation, and reuse of public space after the Late Bronze Age destruction are central to understanding the transition from Troy VI/VII to Iron Age Ilion. The term “agora” requires particular caution because it carries institutional connotations from later Greek urbanism; applying it to a Late Bronze Age space needs architectural, artefactual, and comparative support.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 2026年发掘报道聚焦特洛伊VI南门前空间。发掘者认为这里在晚青铜时代已具有市场功能，并在特洛伊青铜时代聚落废弃约80–90年后被新居民重新利用；但“agora”这一功能解释尚未有正式论文论证。

**English.** Excavations exposed a public space, paved road, entrance features, and associated architecture near the fortifications, with evidence that settlement resumed roughly 80–90 years after Late Bronze Age destruction.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 其最有价值的学术问题不是“找到市场”本身，而是城市空间记忆与持续性：新居民如何在旧城废墟上重新组织生活，并继续利用具有既往公共意义的核心空间。

**English.** The strongest scholarly contribution is not simply the identification of a marketplace, but the study of urban memory and persistence: how new inhabitants reorganized life among ruins while continuing to use spaces that already carried public significance.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

**尚无同行评议论文 | No peer-reviewed publication yet.**

[Hürriyet Daily News. (2026, September). *Troy’s ancient agora uncovered in recent excavations*.](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/troys-ancient-agora-uncovered-in-recent-excavations-226718)

**现有资料内容（中文）。** 目前没有针对2026年“最早agora”解释的同行评议论文。现有说法主要来自发掘团队接受媒体采访，因此晚青铜时代空间是否确为市场、以及“agora”这一术语是否适用，仍需等待正式建筑与出土物分析。

**What the current source shows (English).** No peer-reviewed publication has yet established the 2026 “earliest agora” interpretation. The claim currently rests mainly on excavation-team statements to the media, so both the market function of the Late Bronze Age space and the use of the term “agora” await formal architectural and artefactual analysis.
